options.name: datacenter
options.description: Destination datacenter where the virtual machine exists.

options.name: folder
options.description: Destination folder, absolute or relative path to find an existing guest. This is required, if O(name) is supplied. The folder should include the datacenter. ESX's datacenter is ha-datacenter Examples:    folder: /ha-datacenter/vm    folder: ha-datacenter/vm    folder: /datacenter1/vm    folder: datacenter1/vm    folder: /datacenter1/vm/folder1    folder: datacenter1/vm/folder1    folder: /folder1/datacenter1/vm    folder: folder1/datacenter1/vm    folder: /folder1/datacenter1/vm/folder2

options.name: force_upgrade
options.description: This flag overrides the guest operating system detection and forcibly upgrade VMware tools or open-vm-tools. This is useful when VMware tools is too old and unable to detect the 'guestFamily' value. Using this flag may sometime give unexpected results since module will override the default behaviour of 'guestFamily' detection.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: installer_options
options.description: Command line options passed to the installer to modify the installation procedure for tools.

options.name: moid
options.description: Managed Object ID of the instance to manage if known, this is a unique identifier only within a single vCenter instance. This is required if O(name) or O(uuid) is not supplied.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the virtual machine to work with. This is required if O(uuid) or O(moid) is not supplied.

options.name: name_match
options.description: If multiple virtual machines matching the name, use the first or last found.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the instance to manage if known, this is VMware's unique identifier. This is required if O(name) or O(moid) is not supplied.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
